name: Omarchy Broadcast
author: Raul Dias
description: Status and control of the omarchy-broadcastd virtual camera in the Omarchy bar: on/off, camera selection, background effect selector (none, blur, replace) and live stream figures.

barWidget.description: Shows the virtual camera's state; left click turns it on or off, right click opens the panel with cameras and live figures.

schema.label: omarchy-broadcast CLI path
schema.description: Optional. Absolute path to the omarchy-broadcast binary (a leading ~/ is your home); a bare name or a relative path is refused. Empty: omarchy-broadcast on PATH, else the repository's target/release build next to the plugin.
